records.title: When2Call: When (not) to Call Tools
records.reason: Potential tool-call cost impact is indirect and unmeasured; this is a behavior benchmark, not an efficiency method.

records.title: AlphaVerus: Bootstrapping Formally Verified Code Generation through Self-Improving Translation and Treefinement
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.06176. Abstract summary: Automated code generation with large language models has gained significant traction, but there remains no guarantee on the correctness of generated code. We aim to use formal verification to provide mathematical guarantees that the generated code is correct. However, generating formally verified code with LLMs is hindered by the scarcity Out of scope: Formal verification of generated code, not inference efficiency.

records.title: SpikeLLM: Scaling up Spiking Neural Network to Large Language Models via Saliency-based Spiking
records.reason: Energy motivation is relevant, but concrete serving-efficiency evidence is absent in the reviewed results.

records.title: CLEX: Continuous Length Extrapolation for Large Language Models
records.reason: Context support is adjacent, but the method does not reduce inference cost or latency.

records.title: LoopFormer: Elastic-Depth Looped Transformers for Latent Reasoning via Shortcut Modulation
records.reason: Budget-conditioned compute is relevant, but evidence is small-scale quality/FLOPs without serving latency, and has training overhead.
